title: Commands with list patterns
description:
Write `public static class Shell` with `public static string Run(string line)`. Split the line on spaces (ignoring empty parts) and answer with a `switch` expression on the array, using list patterns:

| input | answer |
|---|---|
| (nothing) | `""` |
| `help` | `commands: add, remove, list` |
| `add <item>` | `added <item>` |
| `add <item> <qty>` where qty is a whole number above 0 | `added <qty> x <item>` |
| `add` with anything else | `usage: add <item> [qty]` |
| `remove <item>` | `removed <item>` |
| `list` | `nothing yet` |
| anything else | `unknown command: <first word>` |
hints: Put `["add", ..]` after the two exact `add` arms, so it only catches what they did not.
